# קח כיוון (Kach Kivun)

> Hebrew site that helps Israeli pre-draft teens (16-18) find IDF roles that fit them. One personal questionnaire (דפ״ר, medical profile, יום המא״ה scores, interests and preferences) is matched against 300+ IDF roles and returns 5 ranked matches with an explanation and an admission-chance estimate. Unofficial; not affiliated with the IDF.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://kachkivun.com/): what the service does and how the matching works
- [All IDF roles](https://kachkivun.com/role-insights): catalog of 300+ roles with requirements, minimum דפ״ר and medical profile, service length and locations
- [Role pages](https://kachkivun.com/sitemap.xml): one page per role at https://kachkivun.com/roles/<role-slug>
- [Guides](https://kachkivun.com/blog): sourced Hebrew guides to the draft process: roles for women, roles by medical profile and by דפ״ר, women in combat, צו ראשון, דפ״ר, medical profile, יום המא״ה, שאלון העדפות (מנילה), יום סיירות, טירונות, soldier pay, עתודה אקדמית, שנת שירות and מכינה
- [Attention test practice](https://kachkivun.com/attention-test): free one-minute practice of the צו ראשון attention test (tap only the green circle)
- [Role calculator](https://kachkivun.com/role-calculator): pick a דפ״ר and medical profile and see which roles with verified thresholds are open
- [About](https://kachkivun.com/about): who runs the project and how to contact us

## Pricing

- The questionnaire and places 5 and 4 of the results are free.
- Places 3, 2 and 1 unlock with a one-time payment (no subscription). The regular price is ₪24.99; a sale price, when one runs, is shown on the site and at checkout.

## Policies

- [Terms](https://kachkivun.com/terms)
- [Privacy](https://kachkivun.com/privacy)
- [Cancellation and refunds](https://kachkivun.com/cancellation)
- [Accessibility](https://kachkivun.com/accessibility)

Recommendations are not official and do not guarantee eligibility, screening or placement. Role data changes; verify on the official IDF site (mitgaisim.idf.il).
